issues.rescope_en: Re-scoped to phase R1 (ADR 0019 d1, d2, d12, d16, b2–b4, b19). The CIS `shared` schema becomes the tenant master: new columns on `shared.tenants` (account_status, suspend_reason, data_region default 'us', kind, time_zone, bill-to legal fields), the tables shared.plan, plan_feature, tenant_subscription, tenant_entitlement, tenant_entitlement_override and tenant_account_event, and the pilot-tenant marker. Publish `tenant.entitlements.v1` (view, GET /tenant/v1/tenants/{id}/account, event feed). Apps check feature keys, never plan names. CRM `crm_entitlement_pull` enforces allowed_features. Booking `bk_tenant_pull` writes a `booking.b2b_partners` projection for every tenant. `ai.budget_usd_monthly` replaces `shared.tenant_ai_budget`, and retiring that table is new R1 work (AA-1016 is already Done and is not reopened). One `tenant_provision` saga on shared.job replaces the 7 manual steps. Admin gets the Tenants group (Directory, Tenant 360 route, Subscription tab, Plans). Products are content, crm (per seat) and tripplanner (per site). Starting prices 299/799/1,499 and AI included 15/40/80 USD are seeded as policy data. Done-when adds: (1) one-action provision of an E2E tenant lands in all three apps; (2) a disabled feature key is refused live in CRM (403); (3) PLAN_LIMITS, 10/10/50 and UI PLAN_OPTIONS are removed; (4) fail-closed AI budget, moved here from AA-1024 A8: a synthetic E2E tenant with `ai.budget_usd_monthly` = 0.01 USD makes about 30–35 real cheap acc2 calls (~0.0003 USD each, about 1 cent in total) until a refused ledger row appears. No fake spend rows are seeded, because `shared.llm_call_log` has no synthetic flag and AA-804/AA-1026 D6 reconcile on it; (5) the Dev guard: Dev refuses real tenants (kind real) except the one pilot-marked tenant (d16), live before pilot milestone 1.
issues.why_vi: Theo ADR 0019 d1/d2, AA-1028 thành pha R1 và được kéo lên S266–S268. Scope gốc chỉ có catalogue gói. R1 cần thêm control plane: cột mới, subscription, entitlement, saga tenant_provision, contract tenant.entitlements.v1 và các projection CRM/Booking. Giá gói không còn chặn vì b2/b3/b4/b19 đã cho giá khởi điểm, lưu dạng dữ liệu. AA-1016 đã Done từ 31/10, nên bỏ bảng tenant_ai_budget là việc mới của R1, không phải để đóng AA-1016. Chứng minh fail-closed (A8 cũ) nên làm ở đây trên ai.budget_usd_monthly, khỏi chứng minh hai lần. Cách làm là gọi thật khoảng 30–35 lần acc2 rẻ, tốn khoảng 1 cent, không bơm dòng chi tiêu giả vào ledger. Guard 'Dev chỉ nhận đúng một tenant thật có dấu pilot' cũng phải live ở R1, trước pilot mốc 1.

issues.title: [Admin] R6 AA Admin IA and Writing Lab: Tenants group, AA Catalogue vs Tenant content QA, AI & spend, Writing Lab per stage, AA-subject gate, tour retirement fan-out
issues.new_session: parallel lane from the session after AA-1027 closes (~S267) to S275; d21 gate + d20 fan-out slice before pilot milestone 1 (~S272)
issues.rescope_en: Align with ADR 0019. Dependency: README §11 says R6 follows AA-1024…1027. R6 starts once AA-1027 closes; the date-gated remainders (AA-1024 D8 mig 336 ≥10/11, AA-1026 D6 ≥01/12) do not touch the admin IA and do not hold R6. Writing Lab only regroups the UI over the existing tables (d13). The S262 TL-11 freeze on learning logic stays, so 'experiments, prompt versions, eval gate' are views over what exists, not new learning logic, and AA-922 is not absorbed. The AA-subject gate (d21) also limits sales links and CTAs to AA tour pages or the tenant's TripPlanner, allows brand content with no CTA, and holds a failing piece in Tenant QA › Compliance with a content-style reason rather than a bare refusal. The fan-out (d20) covers every consumer: the WordPress page goes to draft after the 7-day notice, Facebook gets a notice plus a flag, the CRM line is marked with an agent task, and Booking blocks new holds. E-mail goes at once when live pages or posts remain, otherwise as a daily digest, with a 'back on sale' mail on restore. SES sending (cents a month) still needs its own cost yes. Ship the d21 gate and the d20 fan-out before the first pilot tenant publishes (~S272). The d18 per-stage Anthropic switch-on (s1_generate/place_card, then tenant stages after AA-820, tp_compose, crm_draft_reply last) is managed from Writing Lab › Releases.
issues.conflict_with_adr: The Writing Lab scope (experiments, prompt versions, eval gate) reads as new learning logic, against d13 (regroup UI only; the TL-11 freeze stays). 'Refused before publish' differs from d21 (held in Tenant QA › Compliance). The d20 consumer list is incomplete. SES send volume is listed in Consequences as needing its own yes, and the S265 cost yeses did not include it.
issues.why_vi: Nội dung đúng hướng nhưng lệch ADR ở ba chỗ. Writing Lab chỉ gom lại UI (d13). Gate d21 là giữ ở Tenant QA chứ không từ chối trơn. Fan-out d20 còn thiếu WordPress/Facebook/CRM/Booking. Về phụ thuộc: R6 bắt đầu sau khi AA-1027 đóng (~S267). Phần còn lại của AA-1024 (D8, theo ngày 10/11) và AA-1026 (D6, từ 01/12) không đụng IA admin nên không chặn R6. Gate + fan-out phải lên trước pilot 1 vì tenant pilot sẽ đăng bài thật. E-mail SES vẫn cần một đồng ý chi phí riêng.
